# Project Instructions
 
## Project Purpose
 
Build a new, responsive, single-page website
based on a supplied Figma design.
 
The website must reflect the intended visual
hierarchy, layout, typography, colour palette,
and content structure of the design.
 
## Before Development
 
- Read BUILD.md before implementing the website.
- Inspect the designated Figma design using
  the available Figma MCP tools.
- Identify the required page sections and assets.
- Review the design information before writing code.
- Identify missing information before making
  significant assumptions.
 
## Development Standards
 
- Use semantic HTML5.
- Use maintainable CSS.
- Use JavaScript only when required.
- Use Flexbox and Grid where appropriate.
- Keep files organized and easy to understand.
- Reuse design assets when available.
- Avoid unnecessary frameworks and dependencies.
- Follow accessible web development practices.
 
## Responsive Design
 
- Support desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
- Preserve the content hierarchy at smaller widths.
- Prevent horizontal overflow.
- Ensure text and interactive elements remain usable.
 
## Quality Control
 
- Compare the finished website with the Figma design.
- Check image paths and stylesheet references.
- Inspect the website at different viewport widths.
- Identify remaining visual and functional problems.
- Report unverified details honestly.
